description: The committed LLM agent recordings of V0.6c, V0.7c and V0.8c (the groups and replays of the V0.9a corpus), each group with its economics and the committed contract reports its runs are paired from. V0.5c is left out: the milestone's scope is V0.6c to V0.8c, and V0.5c's runs are single benchmark runs with no suite contract to pair them with no action. Suite economics are never combined across groups.

caseStudies.title: 1. V0.7c stage B, staffing shortage, Qwen (90 days): hires, terminations and credit
caseStudies.why: The run V0.7c described as drawing on credit (docs/benchmark/v07c-dev/README.md §5). Its eventual losses are already known; this reconstruction keeps them out of each decision point and shows what was observable when each hire, termination, allocation change and extension was decided.
caseStudies.limits: Limits: llm-agent 2 recorded only the final reply at each point, so earlier refused attempts are counted but not shown. The later losses are observed run-level differences (C) and are not attributed to the hires or terminations; doing so would need runs that differ only in one decision, which were not performed.

caseStudies.title: 2. Contrast: V0.7c stage A, staffing shortage, Gemma (30 days): limited intervention
caseStudies.why: The same scenario and economics with one executed action. It is a contrast in what was done, not a paired comparison with case 1: the horizon (30 days) and the seed (41602) differ.
caseStudies.limits: Limits: a different seed and horizon from case 1, so no difference between the two cases is a measured effect of intervening less.

caseStudies.title: 3. V0.8c, low liquidity, Qwen (30 days): affordability refusals
caseStudies.why: The run with the most funding refusals (8 of V0.8c's 10). llm-agent 3 records every attempt, so each refused batch is shown with the engine's commitment and headroom at that moment.
caseStudies.limits: Limits: one seed of one scenario. What the agent did after each refusal is described by refusal-response v2 (V0.8c) and is not re-analysed here.
